notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] fixed minor visual and audio bugs
[*] added exit points on the hub stage
[*] edited some objectives and victory screen text for better clarity
[*] your units now get restored to full health before the fight against the pirate on stage 4
[*] added a few lines of dialogue
[*] you can no longer talk to neutral NPCs after killing them
[/list]
